authority: the open-PR snapshot the overlap readers share (BH-782 cache; BH-9440 hub refresh)
note:
state/overlap-guard/

-prs.json: a cache, never a source of truth. Written by bin/overlap-guard.sh (its launch check, and `--refresh

`, which bin/fly-pool.sh calls once per tick when rows are queued and the file is older than OVERLAP_PR_CACHE_SECS); read by bin/sibling-serial.sh and bin/overlap-schedule.sh while younger than OVERLAP_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE, and by the guard itself.

-files/. and main. hold one PR's or one commit's file list; each refresh deletes the ones the new snapshot does not name.

.alerted- is the one-alert-per-day marker of a failed refresh; markers older than 2 days are deleted by the refresh. Never carried: a box with no copy refreshes on its next tick

state/pool-marks/

/.cheap-at: the epoch of the last free-tier cheap first list bin/fly-pool.sh ran for a queued key (pool_cheap_list), so a key with no list is tried once per POOL_CHEAP_LIST_TTL_S; ..cheap-body is the queue row's body for that one run, removed after it. .after-stuck: the UTC date of the last AFTER STUCK alert line for that blocker (pool_after_stuck_alert), one line per blocker per day. They are throttles of this hub's tick, not pool rows, so they are not under state/pool/. Each write deletes the expired markers (cheap-at older than the TTL, after-stuck older than 2 days). Losing one costs one repeated free listing or one repeated alert line. Machine-local, never carried
